changeSet.author: nexus-u5m5g.3
changeSet.comment: Creates nexus.catalog_reconcile_runs and nexus.catalog_reconcile_rows (RDR-193 Part A1 item 1: the landing tables of a catalog reconcile run) with tenant RLS (ENABLE + FORCE + tenant_isolation). New tables only, so no data mutation of existing rows.

changeSet.author: nexus-u5m5g.3
changeSet.comment: nexus.catalog_reconcile_commit(p_owner text, p_run_id text) RETURNS jsonb (RDR-193 Part A1 item 2): the one-transaction commit of a staged reconcile run. plpgsql, VOLATILE, SECURITY INVOKER, so RLS applies. A function definition and its GRANT EXECUTE; no data effect at migration time.

rollback.sql: REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION nexus.catalog_reconcile_commit(text, text) FROM nexus_svc; DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS nexus.catalog_reconcile_commit(text, text);

changeSet.author: nexus-u5m5g.3
changeSet.comment: nexus.catalog_reconcile_reap(p_interval interval) RETURNS integer (RDR-193 Part A1 item 3): drops the tenant's reconcile runs created longer ago than the interval (default 24 hours), committed or not, with their landing rows; returns the number of runs dropped. A function definition and its GRANT EXECUTE; no data effect at migration time.

rollback.sql: REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION nexus.catalog_reconcile_reap(interval) FROM nexus_svc; DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS nexus.catalog_reconcile_reap(interval);

changeSet.author: nexus-u5m5g.3
changeSet.comment: nexus.catalog_link_write(p_from, p_to, p_link_type, p_from_span, p_to_span, p_created_by, p_if_absent) RETURNS text (RDR-193 fix round r1): the one link write, today's POST /link as a function. plpgsql, VOLATILE, SECURITY INVOKER. The reconcile commit's rename move calls it per link, and Step 3's batch link route reuses it. A function definition and its GRANT EXECUTE; no data effect at migration time.

rollback.sql: REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION nexus.catalog_link_write(text, text, text, text, text, text, boolean) FROM nexus_svc; DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS nexus.catalog_link_write(text, text, text, text, text, text, boolean);

changeSet.author: nexus-u5m5g.4
changeSet.comment: nexus.catalog_link_endpoint(p_end jsonb) RETURNS text and nexus.catalog_links_upsert_many(p_edges jsonb) RETURNS TABLE(created integer, skipped integer, unresolved jsonb) (RDR-193 Part A4 item 1, Step 3): the batch link upsert. plpgsql, VOLATILE, SECURITY INVOKER. Function definitions and their GRANT EXECUTE; no data effect at migration time.

changeSet.author: nexus-u5m5g.4
changeSet.comment: nexus.catalog_link_same_content(p_tumblers text[], p_prune boolean) RETURNS jsonb (RDR-193 Part A4 item 3, Step 3): the same-as linker generate_pdf_corpus_links and prune_stale_same_as_links apply today, in one transaction. plpgsql, VOLATILE, SECURITY INVOKER. A function definition and its GRANT EXECUTE; no data effect at migration time.

rollback.sql: REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION nexus.catalog_link_same_content(text[], boolean) FROM nexus_svc; DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS nexus.catalog_link_same_content(text[], boolean);
